label.purpose: Branch metadata, state, counts, and freshness.

mono.purpose: Exact commit hashes and inspector values.

shadows.name: pale-rail-keyline
shadows.purpose: Structural contrast for yellow station rings; never elevation.

motion.name: pan-feedback
motion.value: smooth scrolling; instant when prefers-reduced-motion is reduce
motion.purpose: Short user-invoked horizontal panning only; initial placement and state preservation are immediate.

components.name: Control Button
components.description: Compact bordered control for locate, pan, refresh, copy, and dismiss actions.
components.css: .ds-control { min-height: 44px; padding: 8px 10px; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 6px; background: var(--surface); color: var(--text); font: .875rem/1.45 ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; text-align: left; cursor: pointer; } .ds-control:hover { background: var(--surface-raised); } .ds-control:active { background: var(--accent-soft); } .ds-control:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-control:disabled { cursor: wait; color: var(--muted); }

components.name: Commit Station
components.description: A semantic 44px commit target with a precise branch-colored station ring.
components.css: .ds-station { position: relative; width: 44px; height: 44px; min-width: 44px; padding: 0; border: 0; border-radius: 50%; background: transparent; color: var(--text); cursor: pointer; } .ds-station:hover { background: var(--accent-soft); } .ds-station:active { background: var(--accent-soft); } .ds-station:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-station-dot { position: absolute; left: 50%; top: 50%; width: 18px; height: 18px; transform: translate(-50%, -50%); border: 3px solid var(--rail-color, var(--main-rail)); border-radius: 50%; background: var(--bg-canvas); }

components.name: Current Workspace Group
components.description: Flat workspace identity and facts attached directly to its checked-out commit.
components.html: Working tree clean · Publication unknown
components.css: .ds-workspace { width: 320px; padding: 4px 0; border-block: 1px solid var(--line-soft); background: transparent; color: var(--text); font: .875rem/1.45 ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; } .ds-workspace:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-workspace-stop { display: block; width: 100%; min-height: 44px; padding: 4px 8px; border: 0; background: var(--accent-soft); color: inherit; text-align: left; cursor: pointer; } .ds-workspace-stop:hover { background: var(--surface-raised); } .ds-workspace-stop:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-workspace-name { display: block; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; font-size: .9375rem; font-weight: 700; } .ds-branch-meta { display: block; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; color: var(--muted); font-size: .75rem; } .ds-current { margin-left: 8px; color: var(--accent); font-weight: 650; } .ds-workspace-fact { margin: 2px 8px; color: var(--muted); font-size: .75rem; }

components.name: Task Link
components.description: Full-width linked-task row with the navigation action visible at rest.
components.html: QA · Agent — Release readinessOpen taskAgent · codex Last observed ACTIVE
components.css: .ds-task-node { display: block; width: 100%; min-height: 44px; padding: 8px; border-top: 1px solid var(--line-soft); background: transparent; color: var(--text); font: .875rem/1.45 ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; text-decoration: none; cursor: pointer; } .ds-task-node:hover { background: var(--surface-raised); } .ds-task-node:active { background: var(--accent-soft); } .ds-task-node:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-task-heading { display: flex; align-items: start; gap: 8px; } .ds-task-title { flex: 1; min-width: 0; overflow-wrap: anywhere; font-size: .875rem; font-weight: 600; } .ds-task-onward { flex: none; color: var(--accent); font-size: .75rem; text-decoration: underline; text-underline-offset: 3px; } .ds-task-facts { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 4px 10px; margin-top: 3px; color: var(--muted); font-size: .75rem; } .ds-active .ds-task-state { color: var(--accent); }

components.name: Branch Choice
components.description: Branch-index action pairing a persistent line identity with its readable ref label.
components.css: .ds-branch-choice { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; max-width: 320px; min-height: 44px; padding: 8px 10px; border: 1px solid transparent; background: transparent; color: var(--text); font: .875rem/1.45 ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-branch-choice:hover { background: var(--surface-raised); } .ds-branch-choice:active { background: var(--accent-soft); } .ds-branch-choice:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-branch-choice > span { overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-branch-swatch { width: 28px; height: 10px; flex: none; overflow: visible; }

components.name: Attention Link
components.description: Workspace locator that keeps attention semantics separate from branch color.
components.css: .ds-attention-link { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; min-height: 44px; padding: 8px 10px; border: 1px solid transparent; background: transparent; color: var(--warning); font: .875rem/1.45 ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; text-align: left; cursor: pointer; } .ds-attention-link:hover { background: var(--surface-raised); } .ds-attention-link:active { background: var(--accent-soft); } .ds-attention-link:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-status-icon { flex: none; width: 16px; height: 16px; }

components.name: Selection Details
components.description: Dismissible secondary inspector for exact repository and task facts.
components.css: .ds-selection-details { padding: 16px 0; border-top: 1px solid var(--line); background: transparent; color: var(--text); font: .875rem/1.45 ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; } .ds-selection-details h2 { display: inline; margin: 0; font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 700; overflow-wrap: anywhere; } .ds-dismiss { float: right; min-height: 44px; padding: 8px 10px; border: 1px solid transparent; background: transparent; color: inherit; cursor: pointer; } .ds-dismiss:hover { background: var(--surface-raised); } .ds-dismiss:active { background: var(--accent-soft); } .ds-dismiss:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-detail-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(100px, .4fr) minmax(0, 1.6fr); gap: 6px 12px; margin: 14px 0 0; } .ds-detail-grid dt { color: var(--muted); } .ds-detail-grid dd { margin: 0; overflow-wrap: anywhere; } .ds-detail-grid code { font: .75rem/1.5 ui-monospace, 'Cascadia Code', Consolas, monospace; }

narrative.overview:
DevMap is a precise operational map, not a decorative transit poster. A warm paper-like canvas carries charcoal main rails, stable Underground-inspired branch colors, exact station rings, and quiet workspace/task structures. The visual system makes repository relationships traceable while keeping task ownership and unfinished work legible in a narrow Dock.

The interface is compact without becoming miniature. Flat tonal layers, one-pixel dividers, measured whitespace, and a single UI-sans family keep the graph dominant. Color identifies branch continuity; independent symbols and factual text communicate attention, freshness, and uncertainty.
keyCharacteristics: Stable branch identity carried by rail color and pattern
Precise circular commit stations and dashed association stems
Compact workspace groups with visible task actions
Explicit focus, uncertainty, and offscreen wayfinding

rules.name: The Stable Line Rule
rules.body: Branch identity is derived from repository ID and full ref name; risk, freshness, and task state never recolor the rail.

rules.name: The Pale Rail Rule
rules.body: The yellow branch rail always receives the dark structural keyline on warm-light surfaces.

rules.name: The Independent Risk Rule
rules.body: Warning color accompanies a warning glyph and factual reason; it never substitutes for branch identity.

rules.name: The Operational Minimum Rule
rules.body: Workspace names and task titles remain at 0.875rem or larger; meaningful metadata remains at 0.75rem and wraps before type shrinks.

rules.name: The Wrap Before Shrink Rule
rules.body: Task titles and factual reasons wrap; compact ref labels may ellipsize only when the full value remains available through accessible text.

rules.name: The One World Rule
rules.body: Rails, stations, crossing masks, labels, refs, and workspace stems share one CSS-pixel coordinate system.

rules.name: The Current Workspace Rule
rules.body: Initial framing keeps the current station, workspace name, active task preview, and locate control visible at narrow Dock widths.

rules.name: The Offscreen Is Not Unknown Rule
rules.body: A route outside the viewport remains navigable through endpoint wayfinding; only unavailable history receives a boundary treatment.

rules.name: The Flat Operational Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are separated by tone and one-pixel rules; shadows do not imply card hierarchy, and the station keyline is structural rather than elevation.

rules.name: The Station Ring Rule
rules.body: Commit nodes are circular rings centered on their rail; dashed rings mean boundaries, not ordinary commits.

rules.name: The Crossing Gap Rule
rules.body: A crossing without a commit node must show a local gap in the under-route and must never read as a connection.

rules.name: The Action Cue Rule
rules.body: Every verified task row exposes an underlined Open task cue at rest; inspect-only rows use muted, non-underlined copy.

rules.name: The 44 Pixel Rule
rules.body: Primary interactive rows and controls retain a 44px minimum hit target, including stations and coarse-pointer use.

dos: Do keep branch color and stroke pattern stable for the full repository/ref identity.
Do pair every warning or unknown state with its own vector glyph and factual text.
Do let long and multilingual task titles wrap while keeping their task action visible.
Do preserve native scrolling, visible focus, keyboard panning, and explicit offscreen endpoint navigation.
Do keep current-workspace identity and active task context readable in the first narrow viewport.
donts: Don't recolor a branch to express risk, activity, freshness, or integration state.
Don't draw a junction at a crossing unless the graph contains a real shared commit node.
Don't use floating merge arrows, disconnected origins, or inferred branch-parent relationships.
Don't hide active tasks or risk reasons inside collapsed history.
Don't add ambient shadows, gradients, decorative textures, or floating rounded cards to this flat operational world.
Don't shrink operational names below 0.875rem or meaningful metadata below 0.75rem to make a narrow layout fit.
